description: skills/*.json: what the native reader and Kiln.Skills accept (gameTree as a list, one node instead of a list, {x, y}, Active / Passive / None, GUID config keys, true / false values, program configs by name); a missing "guid" keeps its own message (KL104); no link (KL109), cost out of range (KL107), a link to no node (KL401); Kiln.Skills' Validate: a node id twice (KL305), requires of an unknown node (KL401 error, did you mean), two nodes in one cell (KL310); game-tree nodes without clients mod (KL207 error), with clients mod on a server mod (no KL204), a talent tree without it (KL207 info); talent blocks without it (KL207 error: Kiln.Blocks refuses them)

diagnostics.message: no game-data catalog: 1 reference(s) to the game's items, templates, ... were not checked (make one with `kiln catalog`, or pass --catalog)
this mod has nodes in the game's skill tree but says "clients": "kiln": every client must build the same tree from the mod's own files (the server sends no tree definitions); declare "clients": "mod"
an empty list: a node needs a link, "from" (the nodes that lead to it) or "to"

this mod has talents but says "clients": "kiln": every player's game builds the tree and draws it from the mod's own files, so Kiln.Blocks refuses them below "clients": "mod"; declare "clients": "mod" and side "both"

this mod has a talent tree but says no "clients" (side "server" means "none"): players without the mod can only use it through the /talents chat command; to draw its screen on their game, declare "clients": "mod" and side "both" (vanilla clients are then refused, unless the server's modSync is off)
tree fixture:bad: requires unknown node "frist" (Kiln.Skills refuses the tree); did you mean "first"?
tree fixture:bad: node "first" twice (Kiln.Skills refuses the tree)
tree fixture:bad: two nodes at column 0, row 0 (Kiln.Skills refuses the tree; a node without "col" and "row" sits at 0, 0)
